svg.title: Launched power per mode group for three connector offsets
svg.desc: Bar chart of the launched power fraction in each principal mode group for offsets of 0, 5 and 10 um. A centered beam excites mainly the low groups; with growing offset the power moves to higher groups (EMB 4710, 3874 and 2595 MHz km).
